title: Ring of Bravery
author: user_212495676
description:
It's not that silver jewelry is unaffordable; 3D printing offers better value. Designed in the style of a hero's mask, Print in Place, you can choose black and gray, with a total cost of 0.19. Fast speed, 48 minutes, minimal supports, easy to remove. The ring is generally sturdy and weighty, gradually widening from the finger pad towards the back of the hand, creating a strong sense of three-dimensionality and power. The material has a rock-gray matte texture, securely connected to the main body of the ring, compliant with Print in Place 3D printing technology, balancing visual impact and wearing comfort.
